video_title: Landry Fields Reveals Project B Already Has Players Signed: “It Is Happening”

quotes.speaker: Landry Fields
quotes.summary_phrase: Igor Kokoskov's role in Project B player development
quotes.excerpt: Igor Kokoskov, who is crucial in how we're doing things right now for the development of our players
quotes.quote: The Igor that I mentioned is Igor Kokoskov, former Phoenix Suns head coach, long-time renowned EuroLeague head coach, and he's the head of player development on the men's side. He is crucial in how we're doing things right now for the development of our players from a holistic standpoint.

quotes.speaker: Landry Fields
quotes.summary_phrase: Project B will soon announce signed players
quotes.excerpt: Not too far into the future, it will start to emerge here pretty soon.
quotes.quote: Not too far into the future, it will start to emerge here pretty soon. We want to build with the right players, but you can trust me, it is happening.

quotes.speaker: Landry Fields
quotes.summary_phrase: Project B's player recruitment is ongoing and positive
quotes.excerpt: There's a ton of intrigue with what is known and what is happening
quotes.quote: There's a ton of intrigue with what is known and what is happening that everyone is continuously digging and asking more and more questions. My response is yes, it is happening, and it will all be unveiled at the right time.
